Jarlett just pipped Atkinson over the half-mile stage, but a bad take-over by Bowers lost some ground. The latter recovered himself in fine style and sent Stan.
He also gained third place in the Long Jump. The High Jump saw Atkinson, the Met. Police champion, clear 5 ft. 10 ins. to win the event for the North.

George Bently, Fred's brother, back from the Forces, is with us again, and George Atkinson, also of the Police and a son of ex-Chief Inspector Atkinson, a former Barking to Southend winner, has joined us.
The team of Belgrave Policemen who won the M.P.A.A. 10 Miles Team Championship—Sapcote, Evans, McGreechan and Atkinson. Harry Greene 1st in the Inter Schools race for the Densham Cup.

The handicap team race was won by Highgate with our "A" team, James, Newson, Demmon and Atkinson 2nd. George Atkinson had been moved up to the "A" Team in the interests of the handicap and right well he walked.
A powerful start from Harrow’s Adam Bowden took him well clear of a bunch of a dozen athletes that was gradually whittled down until Blackheath’s Atkinson and our own Davy were alone in 2nd and 3rd.
